about.description: I like building useful, well-organized solutions designed around real problems.

who.title: Who I am
who.text: I'm Agustín Tacconi, a web developer and professional chef. For 2 years I've been building projects with JavaScript, React, Node and MongoDB. I like creating useful solutions for real problems, combining logic, design and a practical mindset.

seek.title: What I look for
seek.text: To step into professional web development, join real projects and keep growing: frontend, backend and tools like AWS.

how.title: How I work
how.text: Organized and step by step: I understand the problem, split it into simple parts and keep a clear structure. When something breaks, I investigate, experiment and ask for help.

stack.title: Main stack
stack.text: What I build with every day.

kitchen.title: Kitchen → Code
kitchen.text: I come from professional cooking. The order, method, teamwork and eye for detail of a kitchen are what I bring to code.
